pages.text: The whole artifact and its beam.

Each hero carries a $(l)part of the artifact's key$(). Put a xel'naga pedestal down and stack the three parts on it, one on another, like a beacon's crystal on its base — zerg, terran and protoss, in any order. The pedestal lights, a violet beam rises, and $(l)high in the sky over it$() (at least 48 blocks up, at height 200 or more) a portal to the Void opens.
The pedestal: a shard of each race over obsidian and an amethyst block.

The portal and its frame cannot be broken. $(l)Take the artifact apart$() — any part, or the pedestal — and the portal is gone.$(br2)Fly into the portal from below, on a flyer or as one, or build up to it. $(l)Units$(): select them and order them onto the portal or onto the artifact — they are carried through by its beam. The portal on the Void's first island leads back to the artifact.
